Dr. Neal invites us to reflect on how we discover purpose, pace, and promise when opportunities enter our lives. Whether anticipated or unexpected, the pivot asks us to move with honesty—gathering wisdom from where we’ve been—so we can move forward with clarity, intention, and courage. In the spirit of Sankofa, our reflections guide our actions, reminding us that growth is rooted in remembering as much as in becoming. Karama Neal, PhD is the principal for the Neal Firm which provides consulting and mediation services. Her practice is built on 15 years of experience in personal and rural development finance and prior work in academic, corporate, philanthropic, nonprofit, and government sectors.   In 2021, she launched the Heirs Property Information Project which grew out of a statewide grassroots organization she started in 2013 to promote passage of the Uniform Partition of Heirs Property Act.  
Previously, she was the Biden Presidential appointee to serve as Administrator of Rural Bu
title: The Power of the Pivot | Karama Neal, PhD | TEDxRochester

author: TEDx Talks
description: Physician and mindfulness pioneer Dr. Michael Krasner invites us to reconsider what it means to be whole.  His message is an offering: that each of us is already whole, not despite our brokenness, but through it Michael Krasner, MD, FACP, is Co-Chief Medical Officer and Vice President of Education at EmPRO Insurance Company and Professor Emeritus of Medicine at the University of Rochester. For over two decades, he has taught mindfulness-based programs to thousands of patients and health professionals, helping transform how medicine approaches well-being, resilience, and compassionate care. He co-directs the internationally recognized Mindful Practice in Medicine programs, which offer retreats, training, and global Centers of Excellence in Australia, Europe, and North America. His pioneering Mindful Communication study, published in JAMA, helped establish mindfulness in clinical practice. Dr. Krasner also hosts the podcast Flourishing in Medicine and produced the documentary The Healer
title: You're not broken | Michael Krasner, MD | TEDxRochester

author: TEDx Talks
description: I've been a human guinea pig taking every health test possible that doesn't hurt me over the past 25 years. What have I have learned about my health—present and future—and what does this mean for you? David Ewing Duncan is an award-winning science and technology journalist, researcher, and entrepreneur. He is a best-selling author of 12 books published in 21 languages and writes for Wired, The New York Times, Vanity Fair, MIT Technology Review,  Scientific American, and many others. He is a former producer and correspondent for ABC Nightline and 20/20, and for NPR’s Morning Edition. He was the Director of the Center for Life Science Policy at UC Berkeley. David co-founded three companies and is the Co-Founder and CEO of Arc Fusion, and was a Health Entrepreneur in Residence at IDEO. His latest book is Microlands: The Future of Life on Earth (and why it’s smaller than you think) (LittleBrownUK and Harvard U Press) about the microbiome of the Earth. Other books include Talking to Robots
title: What taking health tests taught me about our future | David Ewing Duncan | TEDxMIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: What does it mean to "go back and get it" -especially when the very premise of democracy feels fragile? Drawing on the Akan concept of sankofa, Tulaine Montgomery invites us to reflect on America's approaching 250th anniversary with honesty and courage. She names the country's central contradiction: a nation founded on bold ideals, built through stolen land and stolen labor —brilliant and brutal at once. And yet, she argues, this moment is not proof that the project has failed. It is proof that the work is unfinished -and urgent. As a student of history and a futurist, Montgomery frames the coming decades as a rare window of possibility: the U.S. is moving toward a future with no single racial majority and unprecedented age diversity, creating an opportunity to rebuild institutions that can finally match the nation's "poetry" with real practice. She offers a practical toolkit for recommitting to an "American evolution": reject "lazy proxies" for excellence, invest in proximate leaders
title: Sankofa and the American Evolution: Going Back to Move Forward | Tulaine Montgomery | TEDxBoston

Angela warns that while AI can simulate love, it cannot replace the biological and psychological benefits that only real intimacy provides and offers practical steps to recognize, protect, and reclaim our uniquely human depth.

For over a decade, she has helped thousands of individuals and couples rebuild intimacy after betrayal, disconnection, and trauma. author: TEDx Talks
description:
Almost everyone has felt the tension when someone in a group says something offensive, and everyone else goes silent. In this talk, Angie challenges us to move beyond performative allyship by sharing personal experiences of being misgendered, facing privilege, and struggling with the bystander effect. With practical strategies and heartfelt insight, this talk calls us to break the silence, act with courage in uncomfortable moments, and make inclusion a daily practice - one brave intervention at a time.

This shares inspiration to build environments where the courage to "say the hard thing, and do the hard thing" is not only welcomed but expected - transforming awkward silences into opportunities for real change. It will explore how supporting courageous conversations and gentle corrections can grow cultures of allyship, so no one is left alone in moments that matter most.


 Angie Freeman, M.S. (they/them) has over a decade of experience in higher education and national speaking on to
title: Countering performative allyship: Courageously calling our own bluff | Angie Freeman | TEDxOshkosh

They sing four-part unaccompanied harmonies in barbershop and modern a cappella styles, and are dedicated to creating community and sharing the joy of making and experiencing music. An accredited Partnership Broker and guest lecturer, she mentors emerging leaders through programs like UNLEASH. author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this conversation, MIT Professor Paul Liang explores how artificial intelligence can move beyond language and vision to perceive the world through multiple senses. From touch and smell to memory and embodied experience, the discussion examines why human intelligence depends on more than data—and what it would take for AI systems to truly interact with the physical world.

The conversation looks at how multisensory AI could augment human abilities, restore lost senses, and even create entirely new ones. By rethinking intelligence as something grounded in perception and experience, it asks how technology might help people sense, understand, and connect with the world in richer and more meaningful ways. Paul Liang is an Assistant Professor at the MIT Media Lab and MIT EECS, where he directs the Multisensory Intelligence research group
which advances the foundations of multisensory AI to enhance the human experience. He is a recipient of the MIT Sony Career Development Chair Professors
title: AI beyond language and vision | Paul Liang | TEDxMIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: Using dinosaurs as a playful entry point, Pat Pataranutaporn explores a serious question: when humans interact with AI, are we heading toward superintelligence—or super stupidity? Drawing on his research at the MIT Media Lab, he examines how AI shapes human psychology, from long-term decision-making to addiction and well-being. By designing AI systems that support reflection, transparency, and human flourishing, Pat argues that the most important question isn’t what AI can do—but what it is doing to us. Pat Pataranutaporn, PhD is an assistant professor, technologist, and researcher at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), where he is the founding director of the Cyborg Psychology research group. He also serves as co-director of the MIT Media Lab Advancing Humans with AI (AHA) Research Program. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Superintelligence or super stupidity? What AI is doing to us | Pat Pataranutaporn | TEDxMIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: What can our camera roll really tell us about the world? This talk explores how everyday photos, taken on our phones, secretly capture shadows, reflections, and even individual photons—and how new AI systems can use these hidden signals to see the invisible 3D world around us. Nikhil Behari is a graduate student in the Camera Culture group at the MIT Media Lab and a NASA Space Technology Graduate Research Fellow. His research at MIT is centered around designing new AI systems that use hidden visual cues captured by everyday cameras to see the invisible 3D world around us. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The hidden information in your photos | Nikhil Behari | TEDxMIT

Cory Hepola challenges the negative narratives around small towns and asks a simple, powerful question: what stories are you choosing to pin up for the world to see? It’s a warm, reflective look at pride, place, and the power of positive storytelling. A three-time Emmy-winning storyteller, Cory Hepola brings small-town America to life through the acclaimed “My Town” documentary series. As Vice President of Communications, Growth, and Strategy at The Brookshire Company, Cory uses narrative to connect people and ideas. Whether on screen or on stage, he is driven by one question: how do we rediscover what matters most in the places we call home? Impariamo a disconnetterci dal ronzio elettrico della quotidianità per riaccordarci alla nostra firma sonora naturale, trasformando ogni nostra interazione in un atto di riconoscimento profondo dell'altro. Un TEDx talk e una performance intensa per The Age of Care, dove la musica diventa un gesto di aiuto, di connessione, di cura.
Sergio Bellotti e Loris Lombardo ci guidano in un viaggio sonoro terapeutico, fatto di parole ritmo, respiro e silenzi.

Sergio Bellotti è un artista internazionale e un uomo del Rinascimento. 
Come batterista potente e straordinariamente dotato, ha suonato con alcuni dei migliori musicisti del mondo. 
Come educatore, è un richiesto docente e professore presso la stimata Berklee College of Music. 
Come imprenditore, è proprietario di 247Drums, che soddisfa le esigenze dei batteristi di tutto il mondo.
Originario di Bari, la passione di Sergio per la musica e la sua abilità alla batteria lo hanno spinto a trasferirsi a Boston nel 1995 per frequentare il Berklee College of Music. Poco dopo il suo arrivo negli Stati Uniti, Sergio ha incontrato il suo partner musicale di lunga data, il connazionale espatriato e straordinario

description: „Jesteś tak szybki jak twoja osada” – to zdanie towarzyszy Agnieszce przez jej całą sportową karierę. Na igrzyskach przekonała się, że nawet jeśli jesteś w top formie, nic nie znaczysz bez drużyny. Czy w sporcie czy w życiu potrzeba jest współpraca, aby osiągać cele. To wystąpienie to jej historia o tym, jak zaufanie, szczerość i wspólny rytm prowadzą nie tylko do medalu, ale i do lepszego życia na co dzień. To jest lekcja, którą każdy może wykorzystać – w biznesie, w szkole, w codziennym życiu. Wicemistrzyni Olimpijska z Tokio 2020/21, brązowa medalistka z Rio 2016, mistrzyni świata i Europy. Współautorka książki „Mój wyścig z depresją”, członkini zarządu Polskiego Komitetu Olimpijskiego i prezeska Stowarzyszenia Olimpijskiego Wygrywamy. Propaguje zdrowy styl życia, aktywność fizyczną i rolę zdrowia psychicznego w sporcie. Prowadzi klub wioślarski, inspirując amatorów niezależnie od wieku. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized
title: Jesteś tak szybki jak twoja osada | Agnieszka Kobus-Zawojska | TEDxKoszalin

author: TEDx Talks
description: Astrofizikçi & Bilim İletişimcisi Lisans ve yüksek lisans öğrenimini Ankara Üniversitesi Astronomi ve Uzay Bilimleri Bölümü’nde tamamladı. Oxford Üniversitesi Astrofizik Bölümü’nde doktora derecesini almıştır. Dış galaksilerde moleküler gaz gözlem ve analizi, gaz kinematiği ve galaksi evrimi alanlarında çalışmalar yapmaktadır. Doktora süresince bir yıl kadar Nagoya Üniversitesi Astronomi Bölümü’nde ziyaretçi araştırmacı olarak bulunmuştur. Doktora çalışmalarının ilki Association of British Turkish Academics tarafından doğa bilimleri alanında Mansiyon ödülüne layık görülmüştür. Uzmanlık alanında birçok uluslararası makale ve bildirisi bulunan Topal Kaostan Kozmosa Evrenin Hikayesi isimli popüler bilim ve astronomi kitabının yazarıdır. Uzay ve bilimi ilgilenen herkese en doğru ve en ilgi çekici şekilde ulaştırmayı hedefleyen ve alanında ülkemizdeki en büyük sosyal sorumluluk projesi olan Gelecek Uzayda projesini 2013 yılında başlatan Topal 2025 yılı itibarıyla yüzbinl
title: Işınlanmak Orucu Bozar mı? | Selçuk Topal | TEDxVizyon Koleji Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Na bieżni decydują sekundy. W polskim sporcie - często decyzje.

Anna Kiełbasińska, medalistka olimpijska, wielokrotna medalistka Mistrzostw Świata oraz Europy, opowiada historię swojej drogi – pełnej sukcesów, kontuzji i decyzji, które często nie zależały od niej.

To opowieść o determinacji, która pozwala przetrwać, ale też o systemie, który zbyt często testuje nie tylko ciało, ale i psychikę sportowca.

Nie o narzekaniu - o odwadze, żeby stanąć za sobą.

I o tym, że jeśli chcemy w Polsce naprawdę wygrywać, musimy biec szybciej niż system. Od ponad 20 lat związana ze sportem, w którym konsekwentnie przełamywała bariery – fizyczne, psychiczne i społeczne. Pomimo choroby, która mogła zakończyć jej karierę, dzięki holistycznemu podejściu i sile determinacji zbudowała własną drogę do sukcesu. Łączy doświadczenie sportowca z pasją do rozwoju, ucząc, jak świadomie dbać o ciało, umysł i energię życiową. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently o
title: Czy charakter wystarczy, żeby wygrać? | Anna Kiełbasińska | TEDxKoszalin

author: TEDx Talks
description: Aktualizujesz aplikacje, system w telefonie, a co z Twoim najważniejszym oprogramowaniem – Tobą? Sukcesy z przeszłości potrafią zbudować wygodne więzienie, które blokuje Twój rozwój. Posłuchaj, jak jeden bieg może skończyć się maratonem w Londynie i co daje odwaga, by stanąć przed kimś takim jak 50 Cent. Otrzymaj narzędzia, by wyłączyć autopilota i zacząć świadomie projektować swoją przyszłość. Greg Albrecht od ponad 20 lat wspiera liderów w rozwijaniu potencjału i budowaniu skutecznych organizacji. Partner w Momentum Capital Partners, gdzie pomaga firmom w skalowaniu, oraz założyciel Albrecht & Partners i podcastu Greg Albrecht Podcast. Łączy strategiczne myślenie z empatią, czerpiąc z doświadczeń trenera, maratończyka i ojca. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Zaktualizuj swoje oprogramowanie | Greg Albrecht | TEDxKoszalin
